app.name: OCR MiniTool
drop.big: Drop images here, or click to browse
drop.sub: Supports jpg / png / bmp / webp / tiff, multi-select; PDFs are converted page-by-page automatically
ocr.modeTip: Merged parsing = multiple files treated as pages of one document (cross-page context); Batch = each file recognized independently with its own result
ocr.promptDesc: Leave empty for the model default (document parsing); type a custom prompt to fine-tune the output
ocr.promptPlaceholder: Default is Markdown document parsing; e.g. type "extract tables only" to focus on tables
prog.ticker: {stage}… {chars} chars generated, {time} elapsed (slow CPU inference is normal)
result.title: Recognition result
result.editAllHint: All-pages view is read-only; switch to a page tab to edit page by page
history.title: Recent results
model.engineDesc: The app ships without PyTorch — pick the runtime matching your hardware and download it once. NVIDIA GPU users should choose CUDA.
model.desc: Baidu's open-source long-document parsing model (~3.3B params, MoE + vision encoder). Supports multi-page merged parsing (cross-page context) and single-page dynamic slicing; outputs Markdown.
model.cudaBanner: With an NVIDIA GPU and ≥8 GB VRAM the app uses CUDA + bfloat16 (requires the CUDA PyTorch build); otherwise it runs on CPU — on CPU the vision encoder automatically uses fp32, roughly 20 s to 2 min per normal page and longer for dense tables. GPUs with less than 8 GB VRAM fall back to CPU (small VRAM is slower than CPU). 16 GB+ RAM recommended.
env.noCudaCpuBuild: CPU-only torch build (GPU unusable, see note below)
env.torchMismatch: differs from component version {pin} — install the component or adjust your environment
env.pickFirst: Select an inference engine component first
env.noteNoNv: No NVIDIA GPU detected on this machine — installing this won't enable GPU
env.noteOldDriver: Driver {driver} is below {min} required by CUDA 12.8 — update your NVIDIA driver first
env.done: Engine ready (torch {ver}) — you can load the model now
env.flavorSetNeedDl: Saved "{label}" — click "Download component" to fetch it (~{size} MB).
env.flavor.cpuDesc: For machines without a discrete GPU, or with AMD/Intel GPUs; CPU inference is slow (about 20 s to 2 min per normal page, longer for dense pages).
env.flavor.cu128Desc: Best for NVIDIA GPUs, an order of magnitude faster than CPU; bundles the CUDA 12.8 runtime (no Toolkit needed); requires driver 570+.
err.noTorchComponent: Inference engine component is not installed — download it above (choose CPU / CUDA by your GPU) first.
err.envBusy: Engine component download in progress — wait for it or cancel first.
set.modelDirDesc: Storage directory for Unlimited-OCR-2; empty = models/Unlimited-OCR-2 under the app folder
set.mirrorDesc: Use a mirror (e.g. hf-mirror.com) when huggingface.co is slow or unreachable
set.deviceDesc: auto = CUDA when an NVIDIA GPU is present, otherwise CPU
set.outfmtDesc: File format for auto-saved results (the Save button follows it too)
set.pyDesc: The app normally runs in its bundled venv, whose PyTorch is CPU-only. Point it at another interpreter / venv (e.g. one with CUDA PyTorch); takes effect after an app restart
set.pyCustomDesc: Accepts python.exe or a venv folder; empty = default environment. Run a check before applying — applying restarts the app with this interpreter
set.pyCheckDesc: Check shows the target interpreter's torch / CUDA / transformers; Apply saves and restarts the app
py.emptyPath: Enter an interpreter path first (to restore the default, click "Use default")
py.checking: Checking… (first torch import can take tens of seconds)
py.probeTimeout: Probe timed out (>120 s); verify the interpreter works
py.probeBadOutput: Could not parse probe output (target process died)
py.cudaBuildNoGpu: CUDA torch build, but no usable GPU ({build})
py.depsMissing: ⚠ torch / transformers incomplete — recognition will fail in this environment
py.depsOkHint: Dependencies complete; you can apply & restart
py.restarting: Restarting the app with the new interpreter…
py.frozenUnsupported: Interpreter switching is unavailable in the packaged build
py.sameInterpreter: That interpreter is already in use
about.desc: Local inference · your data never leaves this computer
msg.modeBatch: Batch: each file is recognized independently with its own result (images and PDFs can be mixed)
msg.modeMerged: Merged: the files will be combined as pages of one document (cross-page context)
msg.cancelRequested: Cancellation requested; decoding stops within 1–2 seconds (the current vision-encoder forward pass must finish first)
msg.readyWeb: OCR MiniTool ready (connected to the local server)
msg.dropOutside: Drop files onto the dashed box above
msg.runningLocked: Recognition is running; changes take effect on the next run
mode.offlineBanner: Backend unreachable — demo mode is on; recognition and settings are disabled. Start the app from the desktop shortcut.
dl.cancelledResumable: Cancelled (downloaded parts are kept; resume anytime)
eng.loadingWeights: Loading model weights ({device} · bfloat16)… ~6.7 GB, please wait
err.modelMissing: Model not downloaded yet — download it first.
err.modelNotLoaded: Model not loaded yet — load it on the Model page first.
err.internal: Internal server error (see logs/ for details)
err.tooManyPages: Too many pages: {pages} page(s) exceeds the {limit}-page limit. Split into smaller files or run in several passes (batch mode applies the limit per file).
err.fileTooLarge: File too large: {name} is {mb} MB, exceeding the {limit} MB per-file limit.
err.noTorch: PyTorch is not installed. Install dependencies first: pip install -r requirements.txt
err.modelIncomplete: Model files are incomplete — download them on the Model page first.
err.noTransformers: transformers is not installed. Install dependencies first: pip install -r requirements.txt
err.noCudaDevice: CUDA is selected as the device, but no usable NVIDIA GPU was found on this machine.
err.torchCpuBuild: The bundled PyTorch is a CPU-only build ({ver}) — it can never detect an NVIDIA GPU, and updating your driver will not help. Please use the CUDA-enabled build of OCRMiniTool; when running from source, install the CUDA build of PyTorch first (see requirements.txt).
err.noPymupdf: Recognizing PDFs requires pymupdf: pip install pymupdf
err.noPages: No recognizable pages (PDF conversion produced none).
err.needMultipart: Files must be uploaded as multipart/form-data
dlg.quitBody:
{label} is still running.

Quitting now will interrupt it.
Quit anyway?
mock.merged1: Recognizing (gundam mode), elapsed 5 s (slow CPU inference is normal)
mock.merged2: Recognizing (gundam mode), elapsed 14 s (slow CPU inference is normal)
mock.batchText1:
## Sample heading

This is a **demo-mode** batch result.
mock.batchText2: Recognition result of the second image.
mock.mergedText:
# Sample recognition result

This is the **demo-mode** sample output.
set.maxTokensDesc: Max tokens generated per page/group; 0 = unlimited. Raise it if output gets truncated (slower).
set.maxMergedPagesDesc: Max pages fed into one merged parse; 0 = unlimited. Lower it for very long documents to reduce truncation.
set.cropModeDesc: auto: gundam for single images, base for multi-page (upstream default); gundam tiles the image (better for long/small-text pages, slower); base is faster but squeezes very long images and may lose small text.
set.dropHeadersDesc: Try to remove headers, footers and page numbers that repeat on every page.
warn.truncatedBody: The model stopped at the generation limit (finish={finish}); this page/group may be incomplete.
warn.pagesMismatchBody: Page count mismatch: expected {expected}, got {actual}; cross-page content may be missing.
warn.pagesMismatchUnknown: Page count does not match what the model returned; cross-page content may be missing.
warn.retryHint: Try raising “Max tokens per page” or lowering “Max merged pages” in Settings, then retry; batch mode also helps with many pages.
warn.batchTruncated: {n} file(s) may have truncated output or a page-count mismatch.
warn.logTruncated: ⚠ Output may be truncated (finish={finish}): raise “Max tokens per page” or lower “Max merged pages” in Settings, then retry
warn.logPagesMismatch: ⚠ Page count mismatch: expected {expected}, got {actual} (cross-page content may be missing)
msg.dirScanTruncated: Folder has many files — only the first {n} were added; recognize the rest in batches
msg.dirLimitReached: Pending files already reached the {n}-file limit; recognize or clear some first
msg.scanEmpty: No supported images or PDFs in that folder
msg.scanNeedsBackend: Folder recognition needs the local backend — start the app from the desktop shortcut
msg.mixedSources: Cannot mix uploaded files with folder files — clear one of them before starting
msg.retryNoSource: Failed files are no longer in the list; cannot retry (they may have been removed)
err.envSwitchNeedsRestart: Switching the inference-engine component requires restarting the app (the current process already loaded the old DLLs, which cannot be overwritten). Quit the app, reopen it, then download the other flavor.
